annotations.title: Social Security COLA, wage base and earnings test

description: Returns the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment and related figures from SSA's official annual notice in the Federal Register: 2027 COLA 3.6% (announced October 2026), 2027 taxable maximum (wage base) $192,300, retirement earnings test limits ($25,560 under full retirement age, $67,920 in the year you reach it, for 2027), quarter of coverage, SGA amounts and SSI federal payment. Covers 2025, 2026 and 2027.
